v14_corpus_sufficiency.interpretation: Remaining Runtime V1.3 misses do not justify more training before architecture reconciliation.

concepts.original_intended_function: Offline review of experiences, failures, and candidate memories to strengthen or weaken knowledge without live pressure.
concepts.current_repo_equivalent: Report-only replay, validation reports, CandidateEnvelope schema.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Could mutate memory before rollback and provenance exist.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Scheduled batch replay over envelopes, report-only first.

concepts.original_intended_function: Reduce harmful concept pathways during use.
concepts.current_repo_equivalent: V1.4 pruning projections and lane dampening records.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Deleting or suppressing useful knowledge from one bad case.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Reversible dampening projection only; no deletion.

concepts.original_intended_function: Weaken concepts only in the lane/context where they caused failure.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Overgeneralized dampening could damage recall.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Append-only negative feedback plus lane-scoped dampening simulation.

concepts.original_intended_function: Remove or demote canonical knowledge that is proven corrupt or harmful.
concepts.current_repo_equivalent: No direct equivalent; candidate-store governance only.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: High risk without canonical rollback.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Governed demotion ledger after live canonical store exists.

concepts.original_intended_function: Remember when a concept/path caused drift or unsafe reasoning.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Feedback could become noisy if treated as truth.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Append-only feedback records, never direct deletion.

concepts.original_intended_function: Capture raw experiences/interactions before consolidation.
concepts.current_repo_equivalent: Experiment stores and reports; no runtime interaction capture.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Capturing live user data without policy or retention rules.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Inert episode envelope first; user-approved capture later.

concepts.original_intended_function: Convert episodes into reusable candidate concepts.
concepts.current_repo_equivalent: Learning pipeline and phase governance reports.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Reintroducing extraction/consolidation defects into live memory.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Batch consolidation into candidates only, not canonical writes.

concepts.original_intended_function: Durable trusted knowledge used by runtime.
concepts.current_repo_equivalent: Candidate stores and isolated experiment stores only.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Premature schema freeze and hard-to-reverse writes.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Candidate Canonical release first; canonical v1 after runtime needs are known.

concepts.original_intended_function: Track candidate state, confidence, provenance, and decisions.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Low; inert schema only.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Boundary object for future controlled learning.

concepts.original_intended_function: Convert loose concepts into structured roles/signals.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Poor labels could create false precision.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Report-only signal tagging before active use.

concepts.original_intended_function: Represent why evidence matters.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Overconfident role labels could admit same-topic noise.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Optional metadata and audit precision first.

concepts.original_intended_function: Control concept use across activation, reasoning, planning, and response.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Accidental active blocks could hide useful concepts.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Projection-only policies until a live store exists.

concepts.original_intended_function: Compare competing claims and decide which is better supported.
concepts.current_repo_equivalent: Conflict handling and contradiction reports only.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Could become another opaque scoring layer.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Report-only hypothesis packets first.

concepts.original_intended_function: Prevent confidence from oscillating too easily and track instability.
concepts.current_repo_equivalent: Confidence metrics in reports, no runtime inertia state.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Could hide real degradation if over-smoothed.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Observational volatility reports before active inertia.

concepts.original_intended_function: Independent streams assess evidence, safety, planning, and uncertainty.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Can bloat architecture if made too heavy.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Lightweight report-only multi-check scorecard first.

concepts.original_intended_function: Prevent unsafe action or tool execution without explicit authorization.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Very high risk if action execution appears before gate.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Explicit authorization packet before any action-capable runtime.

concepts.original_intended_function: Safely abstain, route, or answer with bounded uncertainty.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Low; currently inert.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Integrate before live specialist routing or training.

concepts.original_intended_function: Ask a domain specialist when governed knowledge is insufficient.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Provider calls could bypass governance.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: No-provider route object first; calls later behind gate.

concepts.original_intended_function: Learn from selected episodes/corrections under governance.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Could contaminate candidate/canonical memory.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Disabled until explain, route, record, and reverse are implemented.

concepts.original_intended_function: System seeks new information without user prompt.
concepts.risk_if_implemented_now: Broad safety and quality risk.
concepts.recommended_implementation_form: Defer beyond V1.4; require explicit user policy.

preserve_functionally_reimplement_differ: live pruning as reversible lane-scoped dampening
canonical pruning as governed demotion with rollback
specialist routing as a route request and merge envelope before provider calls
DMSA as lightweight multi-check reporting first
controlled training through CandidateEnvelope and replay records
user_decision_points: Should sleep mean scheduled batch replay only, or eventually become a distinct runtime mode?
Should early pruning ever delete knowledge, or always remain reversible dampening?
Should canonical memory be designed before or after output-discipline integration tests?
Should specialist SLM routing be allowed before canonical memory exists?
Should DMSA be a lightweight evaluator scorecard or a separate major subsystem?
What is the boundary between answering and acting for the AEM-style gate?
Should autonomous knowledge acquisition be near-term or later policy-driven work?
